headline: US energy losses from electricity conversion and transmission reach nearly 60%
summary: In 2025, the US consumed 34 quadrillion BTUs of primary energy, with nearly 60% lost during electricity conversion and transmission.
why: High energy losses impact the efficiency and cost of electricity generation, influencing energy policy and infrastructure investments.
